title: Reproduce: Large-Scale Plasma Proteomics Profiles for Predicting Ischemic Stroke Risk in the General Population
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 39704077 (Large-Scale Plasma Proteomics Profiles for Predicting Ischemic Stroke Risk in the General Population) using UK Biobank or a governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the UK Biobank clinical-research workflow of PMID 39704077: Large-Scale Plasma Proteomics Profiles for Predicting Ischemic Stroke Risk in the General Population. Primary endpoint: ischemic stroke risk predicted by plasma proteomics. Use UK Biobank or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, field definitions, linked-outcome logic, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: ischemic stroke risk predicted by plasma proteomics
rediscovery_target: Reconstruct the source study analysis for: ischemic stroke risk predicted by plasma proteomics. Declare any deviations or missing modules.
new_discovery_target: Perform one prespecified, data-supported sensitivity or subgroup analysis; distinguish it from source reproduction and report uncertainty.

data.name: UK Biobank
data.description: UK Biobank controlled-access prospective cohort with linked health records, biomarkers, imaging, genomics, and mortality outcomes.
